content: Across vendor guides (Zapworks Complete Guide to Indoor Navigation 2026, Mappedin campus guide Mar 2026, MazeMap campus guide Jul 2026, Navigine, Ariadne Jul 2026, Pointr) the universal indoor-navigation feature set is: interactive multi-floor map, searchable destination directory, A-to-B routing with turn-by-turn instructions, distance and ETA, floor transitions named explicitly (stairs vs lift), accessibility-aware routing, and an admin CMS that keeps maps current. Zapworks frames the underlying model as a navigation mesh: a graph of every route a user can legitimately take, encoding multiple floors, doors, corridors, restricted areas, walkable vs non-walkable areas and accessibility constraints. The sources also distinguish indoor wayfinding (signage, static maps, staff help) from indoor navigation (technology-enabled turn-by-turn guidance).
